create_deprecated_function: create a decorator to mark a function as deprecated and issue a FutureWarning when called
create_deprecated_class: create a decorator to mark a class as deprecated and issue a FutureWarning when instantiated
create_deprecated_property: create a decorator to mark a class property as deprecated and issue a FutureWarning when accessed
test_deprecated_decorator: test the deprecated decorator with an extra message appended to the deprecation warning
review_is_deprecated_helper: review the _is_deprecated helper function that checks if a function is wrapped by the deprecated decorator
